get.description:
> 🚧 This endpoint is in beta and subject to change. > > A beta revision header (2026-07-15.pre) is required to use our beta APIs. Klaviyo APIs in beta are not intended for use in production. See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. List published marketplace applications, newest first. Filter by ``name``, ``categories``, or ``developed_by``. Wrap a ``developed_by`` filter in ``not()`` to exclude a developer.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/get_client_applications_beta.json)

`developed_by`: `equals` (string) (supports `not()`)

get.description:
> 🚧 This endpoint is in beta and subject to change. > > A beta revision header (2026-07-15.pre) is required to use our beta APIs. Klaviyo APIs in beta are not intended for use in production. See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. Get an application. Owners see the latest saved version. Everyone else sees the published version, or only basic identifying fields if the application is not published. OAuth apps can read themselves without ``applications:read``.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` **Optional Scopes:** `applications:read` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/get_application_beta.json)

patch.description:
> 🚧 This endpoint is in beta and subject to change. > > A beta revision header (2026-07-15.pre) is required to use our beta APIs. Klaviyo APIs in beta are not intended for use in production. See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. Update an application you own. Use this to update application details, such as the application's marketplace listing. Also use this to submit an application for review, withdraw it from review, or unpublish it. OAuth apps can update only themselves, without ``applications:write``; one OAuth app cannot manage another.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` **Optional Scopes:** `applications:write` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/update_application_beta.json)

requestBody.description: Request to update an application (details and lifecycle).

delete.description:
> 🚧 This endpoint is in beta and subject to change. > > A beta revision header (2026-07-15.pre) is required to use our beta APIs. Klaviyo APIs in beta are not intended for use in production. See our [versioning and deprecation policy](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/api_versioning_and_deprecation_policy) for more information. Delete an application you own. Published applications and applications installed by other accounts cannot be deleted. Unpublish the application and have those accounts uninstall it first. OAuth apps can delete only themselves, without ``applications:write``; one OAuth app cannot manage another.

*Rate limits*:
Burst: `10/s`
Steady: `150/m` **Optional Scopes:** `applications:write` [OpenAPI Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/klaviyo/openapi/main/openapi/beta/apis/delete_application_beta.json)

ApplicationCategoryEnum.description:
The marketplace category an application is listed under.

Each member pairs its public value with the value the applications
    backend stores for that category, so the two cannot drift apart.

client_jwk.description: RSA public JWK object. Used to wrap the one-time client_secret as a compact JWE (RSA-OAEP-256 / A256GCM).

short_description.example: Trigger custom abandoned cart email flows to recover lost sales.

installed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the application was installed.

id.description: The ID of the application install: the application ID and the account ID joined by a colon.
The account the application is installed in.
The ID of the application install: the application ID and the account ID joined by a colon.

client_secret_jwe.description: Compact JWE of the plaintext client secret (RSA-OAEP-256 / A256GCM). Returned only on create; never logged in plaintext.

install_url.description: OAuth authorize URL that begins the install flow for this application. Populated on create.

developed_by.description: Display name of the developer that built the application.

status.description: Where the application sits in the marketplace listing lifecycle.

icon_url.description: URL of the application's icon image.

install_url.description: URL that begins the install flow for this application. Null when none has been set.

privacy_policy_link.description: URL of the application's privacy policy.

categories.description: Marketplace categories the application is listed under.

example.title: Grow Your Email and SMS Lists
example.short_description: Automatically sync customers and their purchases to Klaviyo.

gallery_items.description: Images shown in the application's media gallery.

articles.description: User guides and case studies attached to the application.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID of the application. Null when the application does not install through OAuth.

scopes.description: API scopes the application requests when an account installs it. Empty when the application does not install through OAuth.

oauth_callback_urls.description: OAuth redirect URIs registered for the application. Returned only to the account that owns the application, and null otherwise.

short_description.example: DTC ecommerce platform designed for performance-obsessed brands.

description.example: 29 Next helps DTC merchants unlock profitable growth.

banner_image_url.description: URL of the application's banner image. Set on featured tiles.

preferences_link.description: URL where end users manage the installed application.

support_link.description: How to contact the application's support team. Either an `https://` URL or a `mailto:` address.

video.description: YouTube video shown in the media gallery, when set.

pricing_information_link.description: URL of the application's pricing information.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the application was created.

id.description: The account that owns the application.
The caller's install of this application, if any.

Klaviyo-API-Key.name: Authorization
Klaviyo-API-Key.description:
Private key authentication for /api/ endpoints is performed by setting the `Authorization` header to `Klaviyo-API-Key your-private-api-key`
For more information please visit https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/v2026-07-15.pre/reference/api-overview#authentication
